speaker: Goliath
text: Why do you stand there in battle ranks? Choose your champion. Send one man down to face me!

speaker: Goliath
text: If your champion wins, we will serve you. If I win, you will serve the Philistines!

speaker: Goliath
text: I challenge the armies of Israel today! Send me a man. Let us fight!

speaker: Soldier
text: Fall back! Stay behind the line!

speaker: David
text: Who is this Philistine to speak against the armies of the living God?

speaker: Eliab
text: Why are you here, David? Who is watching those few sheep? You only came to see the battle.

speaker: David
text: What have I done now? May I not ask a question?

speaker: Soldier
text: The king should hear what this young shepherd is saying.
